problem_text:
A logistics firm must allocate its fleet of nine specialized transport vehicles to deliver nine distinct categories of cargo. The revenue generated per ton for each cargo type is outlined below:
* For Cargo Alpha, revenue is 17.735 per ton
* For Cargo Beta, revenue is 13.085 per ton
* For Cargo Gamma, revenue is 15.346 per ton
* For Cargo Delta, revenue is 6.165 per ton
* For Cargo Epsilon, revenue is 17.011 per ton
* For Cargo Zeta, revenue is 10.374 per ton
* For Cargo Eta, revenue is 9.028 per ton
* For Cargo Theta, revenue is 9.916 per ton
* For Cargo Iota, revenue is 18.338 per ton

The handling duration required per ton for each vehicle type is as follows:
*For Cargo Alpha, Vehicle 1 consumes 0.386 (ton-hours), Vehicle 2 consumes 1.976 (ton-hours), Vehicle 3 consumes 1.034 (ton-hours), Vehicle 4 consumes 1.329 (ton-hours), Vehicle 5 consumes 1.112 (ton-hours), Vehicle 6 consumes 0.313 (ton-hours), Vehicle 7 consumes 1.578 (ton-hours), Vehicle 8 consumes 0.922 (ton-hours), Vehicle 9 consumes 1.068 (ton-hours)
*For Cargo Beta, Vehicle 1 consumes 1.679 (ton-hours), Vehicle 2 consumes 0.761 (ton-hours), Vehicle 3 consumes 0.454 (ton-hours), Vehicle 4 consumes 0.282 (ton-hours), Vehicle 5 consumes 1.442 (ton-hours), Vehicle 6 consumes 0.319 (ton-hours), Vehicle 7 consumes 1.268 (ton-hours), Vehicle 8 consumes 0.323 (ton-hours), Vehicle 9 consumes 0.403 (ton-hours)
*For Cargo Gamma, Vehicle 1 consumes 0.909 (ton-hours), Vehicle 2 consumes 0.725 (ton-hours), Vehicle 3 consumes 0.393 (ton-hours), Vehicle 4 consumes 1.895 (ton-hours), Vehicle 5 consumes 1.904 (ton-hours), Vehicle 6 consumes 1.933 (ton-hours), Vehicle 7 consumes 1.965 (ton-hours), Vehicle 8 consumes 1.837 (ton-hours), Vehicle 9 consumes 1.219 (ton-hours)
*For Cargo Delta, Vehicle 1 consumes 0.928 (ton-hours), Vehicle 2 consumes 1.535 (ton-hours), Vehicle 3 consumes 1.143 (ton-hours), Vehicle 4 consumes 0.609 (ton-hours), Vehicle 5 consumes 1.596 (ton-hours), Vehicle 6 consumes 0.493 (ton-hours), Vehicle 7 consumes 1.373 (ton-hours), Vehicle 8 consumes 1.91 (ton-hours), Vehicle 9 consumes 1.164 (ton-hours)
*For Cargo Epsilon, Vehicle 1 consumes 0.462 (ton-hours), Vehicle 2 consumes 0.845 (ton-hours), Vehicle 3 consumes 1.119 (ton-hours), Vehicle 4 consumes 0.978 (ton-hours), Vehicle 5 consumes 0.468 (ton-hours), Vehicle 6 consumes 1.277 (ton-hours), Vehicle 7 consumes 1.784 (ton-hours), Vehicle 8 consumes 1.949 (ton-hours), Vehicle 9 consumes 0.526 (ton-hours)
*For Cargo Zeta, Vehicle 1 consumes 1.385 (ton-hours), Vehicle 2 consumes 0.239 (ton-hours), Vehicle 3 consumes 0.47 (ton-hours), Vehicle 4 consumes 1.124 (ton-hours), Vehicle 5 consumes 1.292 (ton-hours), Vehicle 6 consumes 0.646 (ton-hours), Vehicle 7 consumes 1.523 (ton-hours), Vehicle 8 consumes 1.806 (ton-hours), Vehicle 9 consumes 1.946 (ton-hours)
*For Cargo Eta, Vehicle 1 consumes 0.387 (ton-hours), Vehicle 2 consumes 1.43 (ton-hours), Vehicle 3 consumes 1.141 (ton-hours), Vehicle 4 consumes 1.457 (ton-hours), Vehicle 5 consumes 1.88 (ton-hours), Vehicle 6 consumes 0.716 (ton-hours), Vehicle 7 consumes 1.786 (ton-hours), Vehicle 8 consumes 0.363 (ton-hours), Vehicle 9 consumes 0.274 (ton-hours)
*For Cargo Theta, Vehicle 1 consumes 1.865 (ton-hours), Vehicle 2 consumes 0.666 (ton-hours), Vehicle 3 consumes 1.479 (ton-hours), Vehicle 4 consumes 0.596 (ton-hours), Vehicle 5 consumes 1.259 (ton-hours), Vehicle 6 consumes 0.813 (ton-hours), Vehicle 7 consumes 1.501 (ton-hours), Vehicle 8 consumes 1.541 (ton-hours), Vehicle 9 consumes 1.824 (ton-hours)
*For Cargo Iota, Vehicle 1 consumes 1.646 (ton-hours), Vehicle 2 consumes 1.01 (ton-hours), Vehicle 3 consumes 0.429 (ton-hours), Vehicle 4 consumes 1.409 (ton-hours), Vehicle 5 consumes 0.991 (ton-hours), Vehicle 6 consumes 1.476 (ton-hours), Vehicle 7 consumes 1.979 (ton-hours), Vehicle 8 consumes 0.803 (ton-hours), Vehicle 9 consumes 0.999 (ton-hours)

* The cumulative operational hours for Vehicle 1 must not exceed 147.299
* The cumulative operational hours for Vehicle 2 must not exceed 109.409
* The cumulative operational hours for Vehicle 3 must not exceed 97.427
* The cumulative operational hours for Vehicle 4 must not exceed 122.765
* The cumulative operational hours for Vehicle 5 must not exceed 184.87
* The cumulative operational hours for Vehicle 6 must not exceed 104.016
* The cumulative operational hours for Vehicle 7 must not exceed 174.382
* The cumulative operational hours for Vehicle 8 must not exceed 139.707
* The cumulative operational hours for Vehicle 9 must not exceed 161.49

Given the imperative that the total handling duration for each vehicle, from Vehicle 1 through Vehicle 9, must remain within its respective available hour limit, determine the optimal tonnage allocation for each cargo category to maximize the aggregate revenue.
